title: A closed geometric point preserves the differential fibre dimension
statement: Let k be a field, S a finite type k-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and q a prime of S with residue field κ(q) [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. There exist an algebraically closed field extension K/k [def-pc-field-extension] and a maximal prime m of K tensor_k S, contracting to q, such that the dimension over κ(m) of κ(m) tensor_{K tensor_k S} Ω[(K tensor_k S)/K] equals the dimension over κ(q) of κ(q) tensor_S Ω[S/k] [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. No dimension inequality or smoothness conclusion occurs.

source.place: Tag 00TT, proof of (2) => (1), construction of K and m; Tag 00RV for differential base change. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00TT.

proof.text: Construct K as the algebraic closure of κ(q), with its k-algebra structure induced by k → S → κ(q) → K. Its universe is max u v. This construction needs neither a dimension bound nor smoothness.

The tensor universal property gives the K-algebra map φ : K tensor_k S → K, λ tensor s ↦ λ ψ(s̄). It is surjective since φ(λ tensor 1)=λ, so m=ker φ is maximal. The injection ψ gives contraction m∩S=q. The quotient and residue field at m identify with K as K-algebras.

Use differential base change Ω[(K tensor_k S)/K] ≃ (K tensor_k S) tensor_S Ω[S/k]. Tensor with κ(m) ≃ K; tensor associativity identifies the fibre with K tensor_{κ(q)} (κ(q) tensor_S Ω[S/k]). Extension of a vector-space basis preserves finrank (Mathlib Module.finrank_baseChange); transport across the residue-field identification gives the displayed equality. No smoothness criterion is used.

theorem exists_algClosed_prime_over_finrank_differentials_eq
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {S : Type v} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [FiniteType k S]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S) :
    ∃ (K : Type (max u v)) (hK : Field K) (hAk : Algebra k K) (hCK : IsAlgClosed K)
      (qK : PrimeSpectrum (K ⊗[k] S)),
      qK.asIdeal.IsMaximal ∧
        PrimeSpectrum.comap
          (TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[k] K ⊗[k] S).toRingHom qK = q ∧
        Module.finrank qK.asIdeal.ResidueField
          (qK.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[K ⊗[k] S] KaehlerDifferential K (K ⊗[k] S)) =
          Module.finrank q.asIdeal.ResidueField
            (q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[S] KaehlerDifferential k S)
